photon_collision_helper.editor.title: Collision Extension
photon_collision_helper.editor.native_en: Upgrades only this emitter, preserving its name, hierarchy, materials, timeline and native physics. Native collision remains the default. Undo is supported; saving the project keeps the settings after restarting.
photon_collision_helper.editor.title.tip: Nested under native Physics in the editor. Stored paths remain unchanged. Native behavior is the default.
photon_collision_helper.editor.cached_on: Extension settings apply only to Cached Sweep. Native uses Photon's original behavior.
photon_collision_helper.editor.backend.t: Native uses Photon's original particle logic. Extension settings apply only to Cached Sweep; physics is not enabled automatically.
photon_collision_helper.editor.blocks.ti: Test actual block collision shapes. Enabled by default.
Disabled by default. Enable explicitly to test players, mobs or other entities.
photon_collision_helper.editor.fluids.ti: Disabled by default. Enable to test water, lava and other fluids.
photon_collision_helper.editor.includedB: Comma-separated exact block IDs; empty allows all. Example: minecraft:stone,minecraft:dirt.
photon_collision_helper.editor.excludedB: Comma-separated exact block IDs to ignore. Tags are not supported.
photon_collision_helper.editor.ignoreOwn: Uses the entity executor or explicit owner ID. Block playback commands do not supply an owner.
photon_collision_helper.editor.ownerEnti: -1 detects the owner from an entity executor. This is a runtime numeric entity ID, not an entity type.
photon_collision_helper.editor.sourceEnt: 0 disables this optional spawn-overlap snapshot. Positive world-space radius excludes entities initially overlapping the source, never blocks.
photon_collision_helper.editor.ignoreSpe: Ignore spectator players when entity collision is enabled.
photon_collision_helper.editor.pickableO: Only test entities marked pickable by the game.
photon_collision_helper.editor.entityFil: Filters entity categories; does not enable entity collision by itself.
photon_collision_helper.editor.includedE: Comma-separated exact entity type IDs; empty allows all. Example: minecraft:zombie.
photon_collision_helper.editor.excludedE: Comma-separated entity type IDs to ignore. Example: minecraft:player.
photon_collision_helper.editor.sweepEnti: Estimate relative linear entity movement between ticks. This is a client-side approximation.
Inherit reads the native removal and bounce parameters. Use the Native backend for the exact native solver.
photon_collision_helper.editor.restituti: 0 to 1, used by explicit Bounce response. Inherit uses the native bounce rate.
photon_collision_helper.editor.maxBounce: 0 adds no bounce limit. A positive limit stops further bounces.
photon_collision_helper.editor.maxHitsPe: Default 32. Exhausting the budget stops untested remaining motion. 0 removes the limit and is not recommended.
photon_collision_helper.editor.contactCo: Used with deduplication. 0 means once per playback; 20 ticks is about one second.
photon_collision_helper.editor.deduplica: Off by default. Suppresses repeated events, never physical blocking.
Off by default. Share target event records between probes to avoid duplicate bursts.
Emitters in the same runtime share a non-empty group name. Empty limits deduplication to this emitter.
Off uses the particle's world-axis-aligned box. On uses a point sweep instead.
photon_collision_helper.editor.detectSta: Optional stationary volume sensor, typically combined with Pierce response. Off by default.
photon_collision_helper.editor.alignEffe: Align the child FX Y axis to the surface normal; off preserves the original orientation.
photon_collision_helper.editor.blockEffe: Search loaded FX IDs. Empty adds no extra FX. This is additive to native collision sub-emitter events.
photon_collision_helper.editor.entityEff: Requires entity collision. Empty adds no extra FX.
photon_collision_helper.editor.fluidEffe: Requires fluid collision. Empty adds no extra FX.
photon_collision_helper.editor.cachedTil: Each tile covers 8x8x8 blocks. Overflow recomputes shapes rather than dropping collisions.
